apiEndpoints.description: Segment a full document into normalized evidence statements
Simplified alias for segment — minimal required fields
Retrieve all statements for a given document with filtering
Retrieve a single statement with full citation, speaker, and timestamp details

Live validation report with coverage metrics

timestampDetection.normalization: Deterministic — military to 24hr, AM/PM to 24hr, date passthrough

performanceTargets.processingModel: Page-by-page streaming — memory proportional to page size, not document size
performanceTargets.incrementalIndexing: rebuild-index endpoint allows re-segmentation without re-upload
performanceTargets.resumableParsing: Page-level processing; failures on one page do not block others
performanceTargets.memorySafety: No full-document in-memory requirement — pages processed individually
